summary: Correct what is poured over the cheese
before: poured it (cheese, f.) into the cauldron
after: poured it (water) over the cheese in the cauldron
rationale: The Turoyo first names maye (water), then says 'g-maxló-way-no aʕla' (I poured it over it/her), with aʕla referring to the cheese. The edition explicitly has 'brachte Wasser zum Kochen und schüttete es über (den Käse) im Topf'. The present English instead makes cheese the substance poured and omits the over-relation.
